_note: Pilot for the image-led poster direction. Beat-based (hook / context / value / action), variable length, every slide sits on generated art. Content mirrors the agent-lineup story so the vibe is the only thing that changed.
brief: The AI agent that runs my lead generation

hook.prompt: abstract 3d render, glossy molten forms in deep amber and near-black, liquid metal folds, soft studio rim lighting, dramatic shadow, editorial poster art, ultra high detail, cinematic, no text

context.prompt: soft blurred gradient bloom, warm apricot and cream diffusing into white, out-of-focus light study, minimal abstract, generous empty space, editorial poster art, no text

value1.prompt: abstract 3d torus knot in polished amber glass, floating over matte black, volumetric studio lighting, long soft shadow, product render aesthetic, ultra high detail, no text

value2.prompt: macro photograph of a dew covered green leaf, deep shadow, single hard light source, rich saturated botanical detail, editorial nature photography, no text

value3.prompt: aerial landscape of rolling green hills at golden hour, a single winding path cutting through, long shadows, cinematic wide vista, no text

action.prompt: abstract 3d render, smooth ivory and pale sand ceramic forms, minimal sculptural curves, soft diffuse studio light, calm and expensive, editorial poster art, no text
